description:
Debug Network Faster & Smarter with Proxyman

Proxyman is a high-performance Windows app, which enables developers to capture, inspect, and manipulate HTTP/HTTPS requests/responses with ease.
✨ Features
- Reverse Proxy: You can now use Reverse Proxy on Windows and Linux.
- TLS key logging: You can now export TLS keys for Wireshark.

⚡️ Improve
- Windows beta builds now add a download link to the pull request.

🐞 Bugs
- Fixed: Fatal network crashes are now sent to Sentry.
- Fixed: Scripting requests now keep custom Axios headers.
